items.label: US median new-home price
items.note: US median new-home price: Census median sales price of new houses sold (FRED MSPUS, nominal dollars, quarterly) from 1963. Before 1963 the row is Robert Shiller's nominal US home price index (1890-1962) rescaled to the 1963 Census level, so those values are approximate and are not observed median prices. From 1963 the series covers new homes only; the earlier part is a rescaled all-home index. For existing-home price changes see the US home price index vs gold row.

Gold / silver ratio (oz Ag per oz Au)
Gold / oil ratio (WTI bbl per oz Au)
US home price index vs gold, Jan 2000 = 100
more.freq: monthly (3-month average, published about two months late)
more.note: US home price index vs gold: the S&P CoreLogic Case-Shiller US National Home Price Index (repeat sales of single-family homes, FRED CSUSHPINSA, from 1987) divided by the monthly average gold price, with both set to 100 in January 2000. It is an index, not ounces per home, and it is shown in index points in every unit mode. Case-Shiller is a three-month average and is revised.

more.label: US Dollar Index
more.note: US Dollar Index (DXY) is rebuilt from FRED exchange rates with the ICE DXY formula (from 1980) and spliced to the Fed major currencies index before 1980. It is shown in index points in every unit mode and is not the ICE-published series.

more.label: US dollar
more.note: US dollar priced in gold: 1 USD = 1 / gold price in USD. Derived from this page's gold row (same sources and dates: World Bank monthly averages, MeasuringWorth annual history before 1960); not a separate data series.

more_v3.label: Fed total assets
more_v3.note: Dollar-equivalent in gold, not gold owned. Stock divided by same-month average metal price. Overlaps other balance rows; do not sum.

more_v3.label: Treasuries held by the Fed
more_v3.note: Dollar-equivalent in gold, not gold owned. Stock divided by same-month average metal price. Overlaps other balance rows; do not sum.

more_v3.label: Federal debt held by the public
more_v3.note: Dollar-equivalent in gold, not gold owned. Stock divided by same-month average metal price. Overlaps other balance rows; do not sum.

more_v3.label: Federal debt held by government accounts
more_v3.note: Dollar-equivalent in gold, not gold owned. Stock divided by same-month average metal price. Overlaps other balance rows; do not sum.

v3_notes.uranium: Latest uranium may use an earlier month's average metal price. This is not a same-day spot ratio.
v3_notes.overlap: Fed Treasuries are part of Fed assets and public debt; public debt includes Fed and foreign holders. Government-account debt plus public debt equals total debt at matching dates. Do not add overlapping rows.

debt.label: Who owns the federal debt (and the Fed's balance sheet)
debt.note: Ownership split: approximate quarter end. Fed stocks use the last Wednesday in the quarter-end month. Foreign holders are US Treasury TIC estimates of foreign holdings of Treasury securities at quarter-end months (official vs private/other). Other domestic holders are a residual: total debt minus government accounts minus Fed Treasuries minus TIC foreign holdings. TIC and Treasury/Fed debt definitions differ, so the residual is approximate. Non-Treasury Fed assets are NOT federal debt. Dollar-equivalent gold, not gold owned.
